The mealkit freshness replenishment task succeeded with a perfect verifier reward by correctly integrating inventory and finance logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.81 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py' passed the 'test_legacy_node_checks' assertion, confirming the replenishment logic met the required constraints. Future iterations should reuse the current node-based integration while monitoring the 0.19 gap in judge reward which may stem from minor stylistic or non-functional requirements.
